_about: Real guest reviews only. Airbnb reviews (from the host profile, gathered 23 Nov 2026) name their home's unit code; where Airbnb doesn't show which home a review is for, or the quote comes from the old website or the company profile, unit is null and it shows as a review of Escape Away. Ratings appear on the site, and in its structured data, only from these entries. Each text stays in the language the guest wrote it in, in their words; only spacing is tidied. The Airbnb profile's own figure (5.0 from 11 reviews) is in src/lib/site.ts.
